note: Design-Bench v1 LIVE baseline -- the LLM-first product, not the offline builders. Recorded 2026-08-08 by running the 20-prompt battery through the PRODUCTION lane (compose_robot(llm='auto', strict_llm=True), the same call robot_factory.create_robot makes by default) against gpt-5.5, then scoring the recorded designs with the same MuJoCo verdicts the offline baseline uses. Sibling file tests/fixtures/design_bench_baseline_v1.json grades the DETERMINISTIC OFFLINE BUILDERS. The two measure different generators; design_bench.check_label raises in both directions and the two fixtures declare different 'mode', so grading one against the other's floor is a test failure, not a silent re-baseline.
coverage_note: PARTIAL, AND THE REASON MATTERS. 14 of the 20 recording attempts died on HTTP 429 -- the organisation's 50-requests-per-day cap on the fast model (gpt-4.1-mini), hit partway through the run. Those rows measure an exhausted quota, not a design, and are EXCLUDED FROM THE DENOMINATOR by design_cassette.is_infrastructure_failure rather than scored as failures. Before that exclusion existed this same run printed verdict@1 = 0.0 over n=20 -- a number about an API outage wearing the product's label. Every rate below is over the 6 prompts that carry a real design-path outcome.

refusals_note: DESIGN REFUSALS: compose_robot raised LLMDesignUnavailable rather than substituting a template. This is the correct strict-mode behaviour and it is the most product-relevant number here -- these are prompts the product genuinely cannot serve. They stay IN the denominator (scored as schema failures) because a model declining to produce a sound body is a measurement of the product; a 429 is not.

per_case_note: PER-CASE floor over the MODEL-AUTHORED bodies, replayed token-free. It floors the COMPILER+PHYSICS applied to the model's own designs; re-recording is what measures the GENERATOR, and that is a periodic action, not a per-commit one. Every value is currently false -- all four bodies the model built compiled and none earned a credible verdict -- so this floor cannot yet catch a regression. It can only catch a re-record that quietly drops a prompt, which is why it is committed anyway.
